full_prompt_en: A square architectural illustration presents a fanciful house beside a narrow blue canal. The structure rises from a low reddish base near the center, combining rectangular rooms, rounded balconies, a sweeping arch, and a huge ochre semicircular volume behind them. A broad blue upper room projects forward across the middle and contains several small dark windows with rusty red frames. Above it, pale tower-like blocks and short parapets step upward against a cream paper sky. At left, a circular ochre balcony floats on a tapered blue support. Beneath it, a thin exterior stair climbs diagonally from the ground toward a small white balcony. The lower central facade is pale gray and white, cut by an oversized curved opening and a modest entrance. At right, a bare tree with a rounded gray canopy stands in front of the ochre half dome, while tiny figures at the far left and right give the imagined structure scale. A warm gray embankment spans the foreground, with dark teal water along its lower edge. The image is drawn in a nearly frontal view with slight side visibility, preserving the readable silhouette of every block and curve. Pencil construction lines, thin outlines, and a faint square grid remain visible through translucent colored washes. Blue, muted orange, cream, and gray are laid down with grainy watercolor-like variation rather than smooth digital fills. Even studio-like light leaves only soft shadows. Broad empty paper around the house gives its eccentric geometry room to stand alone. The overall composition blends careful measured draftsmanship with playful impossible spatial overlaps.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑插画呈现运河旁的幻想住宅。建筑从中央附近的低矮红色基座升起，组合了矩形房间、圆形阳台、宽阔拱线和后方巨大的赭色半圆体量。宽大的蓝色上层房间在中部向前突出，开着数扇带铁锈红窗框的深色小窗。其上方，浅色塔形方块和矮女儿墙在奶油色纸面天空前逐级上升。左边一座赭色圆形阳台悬浮在渐窄的蓝色支撑上。其下方，细窄室外楼梯从地面斜爬向一处白色小阳台。中央较低的立面为浅灰和白色，被夸大的弧形开口与朴素入口切开。右侧一棵顶冠呈圆灰色的光秃树立于赭色半球体前，最左和最右的微小人影为想象建筑交代尺度。暖灰色堤岸横贯前景，下缘流着深青蓝色河水。画面近乎正面，只略见侧边，因此每块方体和曲线的轮廓都清楚可读。铅笔构图线、细轮廓和隐约方格透过透明色层仍然可见。蓝色、柔和橙色、奶油色与灰色带着颗粒状水彩变化，并非平滑数字填色。均匀如工作室的光线只留下柔和阴影。房屋周围宽阔的空白纸面让古怪几何体独立显形。整幅构图把严谨的测绘式画法与游戏般不可能的空间重叠结合起来。
style_prompt_en: The illustrative style blends precise architectural draftsmanship with translucent, grainy washes. Thin pencil contours, faint construction marks, and a pale square grid remain visible beneath broad color planes, giving the finished image the feel of a studied concept drawing. Muted blue and ochre carry the main contrast, supported by cream paper, dusty gray, and small rusty red accents. Rectangles, arches, circles, and diagonal lines overlap in playful but carefully measured relationships. Edges alternate between ruled precision and softly bleeding pigment. Shadows are light and matte, with even illumination preserving every shape instead of creating dramatic depth. A near-frontal composition, open margins, and a low grounding band make the central geometric cluster easy to read. Sparse tiny scale marks can emphasize the contrast between large forms and fine details. The whole image feels both visionary and handmade: imaginative spatial assembly disciplined by visible drawing logic.
style_prompt_zh: 这种插画风格把精确的建筑制图感与透明、带颗粒的色层结合。细铅笔轮廓、淡淡构图痕迹和浅色方格在大片颜色下仍可见，使成像带有经过推敲的概念画气息。柔和蓝色和赭色构成主要对照，辅以奶油纸色、灰尘色与少量铁锈红。矩形、拱形、圆形和斜线以顽皮却精心测量的关系重叠。边缘在直尺般精确与颜料轻微晕染之间变化。阴影浅而哑光，均匀照明保留每个形状，而不制造戏剧性深度。近正面构图、敞开的边缘留白与低位基线，让中央几何组群容易辨认。稀疏的微小尺度记号可以强调大形与细节之间的对比。整幅图既富幻想又有手工感：想象性的空间拼合受到可见绘图逻辑约束。
theme_en: A visionary blue and ochre house beside a canal
theme_zh: 运河边蓝色与赭色的幻想住宅
name: Konstantin Melnikov
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
